scope: Exact synthetic decision-logic and rational linear-algebra control only. It is not a physical EGB result or a calibrated statistical test.
assertions: A large pairwise separation between H0 and H1 does not imply that either model is adequate.
If every initial candidate exceeds the predeclared held-out residual gate, the policy must abstain and expand the model class.
The outside-family witness H2 passes the same held-out gate, demonstrating that abstention is not a forced permanent rejection.
The held-out observation and gate are fixed before candidate scoring; no post-hoc threshold adjustment is allowed.
This is a deterministic synthetic control, not a calibrated chi-square test or an EGB physics result.
claim_ceiling: This fixture tests a synthetic open-world model-adequacy decision rule only. It does not establish calibrated uncertainty, a physical model, experiment-design superiority, or Symthaea policy performance.
